actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

dimensions.assessment: Affects businesses and investors engaging in geothermal exploration and development.
dimensions.evidence: allow amortization of geological and geophysical expenditures in connection with the exploration for, or development of, geothermal deposits

dimensions.assessment: Provides tax treatment parity with oil and gas industries for geothermal exploration expenses and passive loss rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 167(h)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking `oil or gas' and inserting `oil, gas, or geothermal deposits'.

dimensions.assessment: Alters tax deductions and loss limitations for geothermal investments, implying potential reduction in federal tax revenues, though specific dollar figures are not provided.
Amends two specific sections of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (Section 167 and Section 469).
dimensions.evidence: Section 469(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to federal tax law applicable to taxable years beginning after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by this section shall apply to amounts paid or incurred in taxable years beginning after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Joint Committee on Taxation revenue score or estimate of federal tax revenue impact.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow amortization of geological and geophysical expenditures for geothermal deposits and exempts geothermal working interests from passive loss limitations.
